bullets.text: Delivered Azure-focused data solutions using SQL, Python, cloud storage, and repeatable ETL patterns for analytics consumers.
Supported data warehouse and lakehouse workloads by validating transformations, documenting lineage, and improving data quality checks.
Partnered with business teams to translate reporting needs into curated datasets, metric definitions, and reliable refresh processes.
Applied CI/CD and Git-based review practices to keep data pipeline changes traceable, testable, and release-ready.
